_comment: Per-page canonical overrides applied post-build by scripts/deploy_docs.py (step 3b-iii). Purpose: canonicalize docs-site commercial duplicates onto their marketing counterparts so ranking signals consolidate on the commercial pages. Keys are paths relative to site/. Values are the absolute canonical URL to enforce. Targets aligned to the measured-demand surfaces (Sep 14 GSC audit: /alternatives/ carries vendor demand on all four vendors; /connectors is the commercial head-term pool). See data/research/viktor-seo-decision-2026-09-14.md for the measured rationale.
